comparator.name: Global Management of Social Issues
comparator.sourceNotes: The official 2026–27 curriculum accounts for exactly 180 ECTS: 60 compulsory ECTS in year 1, 60 compulsory ECTS in year 2, and year 3 with 30 compulsory ECTS plus a genuine 30-ECTS mobility window that may be exchange, internship, a minor or an approved combination. Zero-credit GROW development is excluded. The 12-ECTS Wicked Problems thesis and open mobility space remain explicit, and no content is invented for the latter.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest programme owns wicked problems, international organisations, multistakeholder and humanitarian response, project management, global human-resource management and responsible cross-cultural management. Migration and international law form a coherent legal-policy direction, while poverty, inequality, climate change and social entrepreneurship form a coherent social-impact direction. Each produces a feasible and substantively distinct curriculum exceeding the 30-ECTS floor. Three alternatives is the maximum, and every generator-eligible row is owned exactly once.

Entrepreneurship & Business Foundations provides an applied introduction to organisations, collaboration and organisational design.

notes.text: Tilburg integrates organisation studies, human-resource management, sociology, international law, project management and a dedicated three-year Wicked Problems sequence, followed by a 30-ECTS mobility window and 12-ECTS thesis. UCR can build coherent global-governance, international-policy and social-impact programmes, but it does not reproduce Tilburg’s fixed practicum and intervention sequence; the mobility window remains explicit open space.
